public.sns_record.rid: Internal row id. Join target for sns_record_node.record_rid and sns_record_segment.record_rid.
public.sns_record.registry_id: Human-readable registry reference, e.g. SOL-IRQ-0001100257-2610271001. Encodes classification, country, supplier code and date. Null until the entry is issued.
public.sns_record.classification: SOL = sole source (only one supplier can supply it). SGL = single source (several could, one was chosen). Not interchangeable - always say which.
public.sns_record.country: Country the approval applies to, as a readable name (Iraq, Global, Abu Dhabi (UAE)).
public.sns_record.country_code: Country code for the approval. Join to sns_country.code.
public.sns_record.scope_level: 'Commodity' or 'Family'. Decides how far the approval reaches - a Family approval covers more than a single Commodity, so check it against the item actually being bought.
public.sns_record.supplier_id: SAP supplier code. The SAME code as ai.sourcing.supplier_code in sourceguide_db and pir_catalog.suppliers_account_number.
public.sns_record.supplier_name: Supplier name as recorded on the entry.
public.sns_record.reason: One of seven standard reasons: OEM / patented technology, Standardization, Regulatory restriction, Warranty preservation, Active contract / master agreement, Geographic or logistics constraint, Strategic relationship. Quote it exactly - do not paraphrase or merge two of them.
public.sns_record.justification: Free-text business case written by the requestor. Quote it rather than summarising when the user asks why.
public.sns_record.base_status: Approval state. ONLY 'Active' means it is in force. Anything else (e.g. 'Pending Level 1') is still working through approval - never present it as approval granted.
public.sns_record.spend: Approved spend ceiling in USD. If the user mentions a value above this, flag that the ceiling is exceeded.
public.sns_record.po_count: Purchase orders raised against this approval. Currently 0 on every row.
public.sns_record.evidence: Supporting evidence reference for the justification.
public.sns_record.expiry_date: Date the approval lapses. ALWAYS compare against today and say plainly if it has passed - an expired justification is not cover.
public.sns_record.updated_at: When the record was last changed.
public.sns_record.closed_at: When the entry was closed, if it has been.
public.sns_record.renewal_count: How many times this approval has been renewed.
public.sns_record.renewal_of_rid: The rid of the entry this one renews, if it is a renewal.

public.sns_record_node.record_rid: The sns_record this covers. One record normally has SEVERAL rows here - join and aggregate rather than assuming one.
public.sns_record_node.category: Top level of the commodity hierarchy the approval covers.

public.sns_record_segment.segment: Business segment the approval applies to. A record may list several.

public.sns_reason.classification: Which classification the reason belongs to (SOL or SGL).
public.sns_reason.name: The reason text, as stored on sns_record.reason.
public.sns_reason.active: Whether the reason is still offered.

public.sns_category_manager.category: Commodity category this manager owns. Match against sns_record_node.category.
public.sns_category_manager.manager_name: Category manager name. Give this exactly - never invent an internal contact.
public.sns_category_manager.active: Whether this manager is current. Filter on it before quoting a contact.
public.sns_category_manager.updated_at: When the row was last changed.

public.sns_country_manager.country_code: Country this manager owns. Join to sns_record.country_code.
public.sns_country_manager.manager_name: Country manager name. Give this exactly - never invent an internal contact.
public.sns_country_manager.active: Whether this manager is current. Filter on it before quoting a contact.
public.sns_country_manager.updated_at: When the row was last changed.

public.sns_supplier.sap_id: SAP supplier code. Same codes as sourceguide_db and pir_catalog.
public.sns_supplier.name: Supplier name.
public.sns_supplier.closed_at: When the supplier was closed, if it was.
public.sns_supplier.updated_at: When the row was last changed.
